en-US.title: Venture: History Nearby
en-US.subtitle: The history all around you
en-US.promoText: Wherever you are, Venture finds the history around you — each place with a story to read or listen to, and a walk to get you there.
en-US.description:
Venture brings you the history around you.

Wherever you happen to be — your own street, a city you're visiting, somewhere you've stopped for lunch — Venture finds what happened there and puts it in your hand. Landmarks you'd know on sight, and places that left nothing behind but a location on a map.

Each one has its own telling: a short account, about a minute long, to read or to listen to as you walk. Familiar places go further than the sign outside — the whole story rather than the summary. And the places with nothing to mark them are often the ones worth stopping for: a prison that stood for two centuries, a palace that burned down, a nuclear reactor that ran in Greenwich until 1996.

See something and wonder what it is, and the answer is already waiting, one tap away. Choose anything and Venture walks you to it, by compass or turn-by-turn. Save what you want to keep and it stays with you, signal or not.

You don't even have to be there. Look up a city the week before you visit, or the street you grew up on, without leaving the sofa.

• Everything historic within a walk, nearest first, each with a photograph
• Longer stories in chapters, with timelines, for whole towns and neighborhoods
• Read it, or listen hands-free while you walk
• Compass and turn-by-turn walking directions to any of it
• Saved stories work offline — underground, on a plane, abroad
• No account, no ads, nothing following you around

Coverage is richest in Britain and thins the further afield you go. Your location stays on your phone, where it sorts what's nearby and points the compass.
